newsitem.title: USA: Belco makes bid for full control of Hugoton.
newsitem.headline: Belco makes bid for full control of Hugoton.

text.p: Belco Oil & Gas Corp. said Monday it is offering to acquire the remaining shares of Hugoton Energy Corp. that it does not already own for $15 a share, or a total of almost $252 million, the independent oil and gas companies said Monday.
New York-based Belco had previously bought about three million Hugoton shares at $10.50 a share, or a total of $31.5 million, representing a 14.9 percent stake.
The new offer includes $5 in cash and $10 in Belco common stock for the rest of Hugoton's 16.8 million shares outstanding.

The number of Belco shares issued will be calculated assuming a market price of $23 and will be increased or decreased by up to 10 percent depending on the price of Belco stock at the closing of the deal.
Wichita, Kan.-based Hugoton's stock rose $1 to $14 on Nasdaq at mid-morning. Belco gained $1 to $21 on the New York Stock Exchange.
The combination of the latest offer and the previously acquired shares would result in a blended cost to Belco of $14.33 per share, or a total of $280.9 million, for Hugoton, the companies said.
The deal is subject to due dilligence and a definitive agreement.
